stories.title: Follow live: No. 4 UCLA scores late to force OT
stories.summary: Tracking the top plays and developments from Week 12.

stories.title: 'This one is for them': Huskers dedicate streak-snapping win over Ohio State to fans
stories.summary: Nebraska broke its 31-game losing streak against AP Top 25 opponents with a 31-28 victory over No. 16 Ohio State on Saturday.

stories.title: 76ers survive in clutch again despite Herro's 50
stories.summary: The 76ers survived 50 points from Tyler Herro, nearly blowing a 10-point lead late, before once again coming out on top in the clutch.

stories.title: New Cardinals QB Johnson, on 15th team, set to start with Beck out
stories.summary: Cardinals rookie quarterback Carson Beck has been downgraded to out, paving the way for 40-year-old Josh Johnson to start against the Chiefs.

stories.title: Titans DL Harrell hospitalized after car accident in Tampa
stories.summary: Titans defensive lineman Jaylen Harrell was involved in a serious car accident Friday and remains hospitalized, according to the team.
